name: Laponian Area
description: Laponia is a vast stretch of mountains, rivers and lakes in Swedish Lapland, north of the Arctic Circle. It covers about 9,400 square kilometres, including the national parks of Sarek and Muddus, and peaks such as Sarektjåhkkå at 2,089 metres. Every summer Saami herders still guide their reindeer toward the mountains here, following a seasonal migration that has continued for generations.
